name: runpod-comfyui-bfs-v2

source_workflows.operating_mode: V2 first-frame head-swap anchoring, the author-recommended mode for reliability. The graph creates the swapped first frame internally using the embedded Flux/Klein subgraph, then propagates that anchor through the LTX-2 V2 head-swap pass.

custom_nodes.name: ComfyUI-LTXVideo
custom_nodes.reason: LTXV guide conditioning, AV latent handling, audio VAE encode/decode, crop guides, schedulers, and LTX image-to-video nodes used by the V2 graph.

custom_nodes.name: ComfyUI-KJNodes
custom_nodes.reason: ImageResizeKJv2, GetImageRangeFromBatch, ImageCropByMask, ImageConcatMulti, BlockifyMask, GrowMaskWithBlur, PathchSageAttentionKJ, and LTX guide helper nodes.

custom_nodes.name: ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite
custom_nodes.reason: VHS_LoadVideo, VHS_SelectImages, and VHS_VideoCombine for target MP4 load and final MP4 mux.

custom_nodes.name: ComfyUI-GGUF
custom_nodes.reason: DualCLIPLoaderGGUF is present in the source V2 LTX text encoder path.

custom_nodes.name: ComfyUI-MelBandRoFormer
custom_nodes.reason: MelBandRoFormerModelLoader and MelBandRoFormerSampler are used by the author workflow's audio conditioning path.

custom_nodes.name: ComfyUI-RMBG
custom_nodes.reason: SAM3Segment masks the source face/head and guide face/head/hair for V2 magenta-mask preparation.

custom_nodes.name: ComfyUI_Comfyroll_CustomNodes
custom_nodes.reason: CR Color Tint creates the magenta mask tone used by the V2 preparation path.

custom_nodes.name: ComfyUI_LayerStyle
custom_nodes.reason: LayerFilter: GaussianBlurV2 is used in first-frame mask/blur preparation.

custom_nodes.name: ComfyUI_essentials
custom_nodes.reason: GetImageSize+ compatibility node referenced by the V2 preprocessing graph.

custom_nodes.name: ComfyUI-Easy-Use
custom_nodes.reason: easy cleanGpuUsed and easy clearCacheAll are used after the Flux/Klein first-frame head-swap subgraph.

custom_nodes.name: ComfyUI-BFSNodes
custom_nodes.reason: Creator-maintained BFS helper repository. V2 source execution does not require V3 ReservedRegionFrameComposer, but it is installed for author workflow compatibility.

custom_nodes.name: ComfyUI-VideoOutputBridge
custom_nodes.reason: Expose VideoHelperSuite MP4 files through RunPod worker-comfyui's standard image upload path.

core_models.notes: Embedded first-frame head-swap subgraph UNETLoader node 149206.
Author-provided Flux/Klein head-swap LoRA for the first-frame preparation subgraph, strength 1.0.
Source workflow VAELoaderKJ node 5 and audio conditioning path.
Distilled LTX-2 LoRA used at strength 0.6.
V2 multimode head-swap LoRA; workflow_builder maps the graph's head_swap_ltx2_v2.safetensors name to this public asset, strength 1.0.

runtime_inputs.source_face_image_url: HTTP(S) image URL staged into /comfyui/input and connected to LoadImage node 13. Legacy aliases include source_face_image, source_image_url, face_image, and image.
runtime_inputs.target_video_url: HTTP(S) MP4 URL staged into /comfyui/input and connected to VHS_LoadVideo node 28.
runtime_inputs.prompt: Optional prompt; defaults to the author's V2 trigger, head_swap.
runtime_inputs.final_output: MP4 URL from the creator final Head Swap Result Upscaled node 351, bridged through VideoOutputBridge node 9901.

serverless_adaptations: Source workflow JSON is preserved unchanged on disk, then converted from ComfyUI UI graph to RunPod API prompt at request time.
Set/Get/primitive UI routing and embedded subgraphs are resolved into direct API values.
The source rgthree Power Lora Loader nodes are converted to equivalent sequential LoraLoaderModelOnly nodes so serverless API execution does not require UI-only rgthree state.
Runtime image/video filenames replace the demo LoadImage node 13 and VHS_LoadVideo node 28 values.
The author-recommended first-frame head-swap anchoring path is preserved; this endpoint does not silently switch to V3 persistent-template conditioning.
VideoOutputBridge node 9901 is added after the creator final VHS_VideoCombine node 351 for RunPod uploads.

secrets.runpod_api_key: Use RUNPOD_API_KEY locally or RunPod API credentials from CEL-200; never commit or hardcode.
secrets.hf_token: Set HF_TOKEN as a RunPod secret/env var if Hugging Face downloads require authentication.
secrets.civitai_token: Not required for the BFS V2 asset set.
